themes.title: Right-Wing Push for Institutional and Educational Reform
themes.blurb: Right-wing movement leaders in the U.S. and Sweden are exerting pressure on educational institutions and cultural policy. In Sweden, Sweden Democrats are demanding traditional academic rigor and classroom discipline following declining PISA scores, while U.S. conservatives celebrate the removal of law school DEI mandates and challenge institutional historical narratives.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Federal pressure causes the American Bar Association to drop DEI accreditation rules, while administrative clashes alter leadership at cultural institutions.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: SD advocates for new legislation enforcing school safety, teacher-led instruction, and traditional knowledge standards in response to PISA results.

themes.title: Economic Protectionism and Domestic Resource Deregulation
themes.blurb: Right-wing political figures across borders are deploying economic populism focused on direct financial relief, fuel tax reductions, and domestic market protections. Norwegian conservatives demand immediate fuel and carbon tax rollbacks, mirroring U.S. proposals for citizen cash payouts, agricultural deregulation, and import restrictions.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump proposes direct $5,000 citizen dividends while advancing executive orders to shield domestic cattle ranchers and shrimpers from foreign competition.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Frp demands an emergency parliamentary session to slash fuel taxes and abolish scheduled CO2 tax increases to counter rising consumer costs.

themes.title: Right-Wing Parties Battle Electoral Rules and Funding Scrutiny
themes.blurb: Conservative political factions across jurisdictions are dealing with electoral rules, voting map adjustments, and internal party governance ahead of upcoming elections. U.S. Republicans navigate court decisions on redistricting and voter qualification databases, while Norwegian right-wing parties deal with local chapter pressures and candidate vetting.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: The administration pursues voter citizenship database checks and census map revisions while managing adverse Supreme Court redistricting rulings.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Local party chapters press national leadership on core policy stances while individual candidates manage re-election bids following internal complaints.
